_note: Additional Drive folders to crawl for a district, merged with whatever asddo.html links. Some districts publish across more than one folder and the state page links only one of them, so a district can look complete while half its booths sit somewhere else. Booths are deduplicated by (constituency, part) with the newest generation timestamp winning, so listing an overlapping folder is safe — it can only add.
_howToFind: District NIC site, or a folder shared directly by the district office. Check it against scripts/reconcile.mjs before and after adding.

KOLAR.why: Correct 145-Mulbagal folder (264 booths, S10_145_* PDFs, dated 12-08-2026). The KOLAR NIC page links a stale/empty Mulbagal folder (1TLCtL2W6BJkmpeS-CWvQEp67SHwKrHX-, 0 files), so a page-only crawl drops AC 145 entirely. Folder verified accessible with 264 booths.

VIJAYANAGARA.why: AC 89 Hagaribommanahalli (H.B. Halli), from vijayanagara.nic.in — not on asddo.html's own crawl path, so a page-only crawl finds only 2 of 5 constituencies. 254 booths, S10_89_* PDFs, dated 11-08-2026 when first added 2026-08-13; 253 of the 254 re-dated to 14-08-2026 (same folder, same booth set, republished content) confirmed via a live 1-discover.mjs crawl, 2026-08-17. Nested two folders deep (root -> 'hb halli' -> 'hb halli' -> files); collectPdfs's recursive walk handles that at MAX_DEPTH=5. Verified directly via listDriveFolder(), 2026-08-13.

AC 88 Hadagali, one consolidated PDF rather than one file per booth. Filename is a raw CDN id with no AC number in it, so acNo/acName are given explicitly here; 2-extract.mjs still reads the true per-row AC/Part from each page's own 'AC: 88-Hadagali; Part: ...' header, same as Bellary's numeric-filename PDFs. This is a live-updating URL — Vijayanagara overwrites the same CDN path in place rather than publishing a new one, so the file itself, not this note, is the source of truth for its date: was 11-08-2026 when first added 2026-08-13, confirmed republished 14-08-2026 (27031 rows, 218 parts) as of 2026-08-15. Confirmed via parseBoothPdf() that every row is AC 88.

AC 96 Kudligi, consolidated PDF. Same shape and provenance as the Hadagali entry above, including being a live-updating URL: was 11-08-2026 when first added 2026-08-13, confirmed republished 14-08-2026 (21022 rows) as of 2026-08-15. Confirmed via parseBoothPdf() that every row is AC 96.

Older AC 96 Kudligi upload — vijayanagara.nic.in still links this one directly alongside the newer 17867101456473.pdf above, so the raw crawl picks it up as a second, un-tagged file and, without an acNo here, it fell into an orphan 'AC ?' bucket (inflating the district to 6 apparent constituencies instead of 5). Tagged so it merges into AC 96 alongside the newer copy instead. Found 2026-08-15.

AC 90 Vijayanagara, consolidated PDF (41705 rows, 259 parts). Same shape and provenance as the Hadagali entry above, including being a live-updating URL: was 11-08-2026 when first added 2026-08-13, confirmed republished 14-08-2026 (259 parts, all newly-dated) as of 2026-08-17. Confirmed via parseBoothPdf() that every row is AC 90.

AC 104 Harapanahalli, consolidated PDF (29687 rows, 252 parts). With all four added alongside the AC 89 folder, Vijayanagara resolves to its full 5/5 expected constituencies. Confirmed via parseBoothPdf() that every row is AC 104.

BELGAUM.why: Second Belagavi folder, one directory per constituency (01-Nippani … 18-Ramdurg). Crawled and merged: it contributed 0 new booths — all 1,323 of its files duplicate booths already found, at older timestamps. Kept because it costs one folder walk and would pick up anything the district adds there later. Belgaum's 47.7% shortfall against the CEO's count is therefore NOT a crawl gap: both published folders together hold only ~3,000 of Belagavi's ~3,900 booths.

Third Belagavi folder, one directory per constituency with July dates in the names ("09-Gokak ASDDO List 21.07.26", "18-Ramdurg ASDD List as on 24.07.2026"), 2,828 documents. Crawled and merged: contributed 0 new booths. With all three folders walked Belgaum still resolves to 3,464 booth PDFs, unchanged — the folders share the same underlying Drive objects rather than holding different booths.

_finding: Belgaum was investigated across three folders and none adds coverage. Its 47.7% shortfall tracks the age of its own lists, not a crawl gap: median generation date 31/07 against a CEO count current to 08/08. The same holds for Bidar (28/07, -37.2%), while every district publishing from 02/08 onward reconciles within a few percent. Those districts need to republish; there is nothing to find. Davangere was similarly stale/empty through 2026-08-13 but is now resolved — see the DAVANGERE entry above.
